entities.name: Polynesian Navigators
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The greatest seafarers in human history. Using double-hulled canoes, star navigation, and wave-reading, Polynesian peoples colonized every inhabitable island in the Pacific — from Hawaii to New Zealand to Easter Island.
